thread:
tasha: Heads up — release cut blocked. deploy-bot aborted the promote after registry commit failed and final manifest verification showed a mismatch.

ci-bot: [automated] push-step: layer upload incomplete, manifest verification failed (expected sha256:5a3f9c got=sha256:5a3f0000). see job 8133: https://ci.internal/8133/logs

tasha: The client reported a commit timeout followed by 400 on the manifest commit. Looks like a partial layer was accepted then the final verify saw different bytes.

omar: Which candidate did we try to promote? Can we fallback to last-known-good?

tasha: Tried to promote redwood/ingest@2026-04-30-rc13. Last-known-good is redwood/ingest@2026-04-28-rc12.

release-manager: We have the maintenance window starting at 16:00UTC (schema migration). If this is flaky I'd prefer pin to rc12 and avoid risking the window. Rollback during the window is risky.

infra: I'm digging into registry and the upload proxy. I see a spike of FIN/RESET on the upload worker at 15:41UTC, followed by a stale multipart temp file left on disk. Restarted the upload worker and cleared temp parts.

omar: Could be runner-side short-write or proxy reset. Any runner logs?

tasha: Runner was runner-33. Log excerpt: 
```
[blob-uploader] WARN wrote 4120000 of 4521984 before EOF
[client] ERROR commit failed: short write
[verify] ERROR mismatch: expected sha256:5a3f9c got sha256:5a3f0000
```

ci-bot: job 8133 (rerun) queued on runner-34 (fresh host) after infra restart.

release-manager: If the rerun succeeds within 10m we can consider re-promote, but we must not delay the migration. Proposal: manual pin to rc12 and annotate release notes, then perform a controlled re-promote after post-release smoke and a quick hotfix pipeline. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

omar: +1 pin. Safer for the window. We'll document the failed artifact and reattempt once we have root-cause.

tasha: Agreed. Manual pin: /promote redwood/ingest@2026-04-28-rc12 --reason "safety pin: rc13 manifest verification failed (partial layer/commit)"

deploy-bot: Promotion queued. Running pre-promotion checks.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete — redwood/ingest@2026-04-28-rc12 promoted to candidate. Release notes appended: "Pinned to last-known-good after registry manifest verification failure on newer candidate; will reattempt promotion after investigation."

ci-bot: job 8133 (rerun) finished: SUCCESS on runner-34. Artifact verified and manifest accepted on rerun.

release-manager: Rerun succeeded but we kept the pin to avoid change window risk. We'll schedule a controlled re-promote post-migration if smoke passes.

infra: Opening INFRA-2001 to investigate: root causing upload resets, ensure upload-worker doesn't leave stale multipart parts, add server-side check for part checksums. Assigning to infra and release eng.

omar: Also recommend adding client-side preflight and a small retry loop for multipart part uploads; will draft a PR for uploader.

tasha: Action items: omar — PR for preflight+retry; infra — INFRA-2001 triage and add monitoring alert for partial-part leftovers; release-manager — update release notes and notify stakeholders about pin and re-promote plan.

infra: I'll keep the registry and upload proxy on watch for the next 6 hours and collect pcap if the reset pattern returns.

release-manager: Thanks all. We'll reconvene here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
